title: Planck's equation

items.label: E
items.meaning: energy of a photon (J)

items.label: h
items.meaning: Planck's constant (J·s)

items.label: \nu
items.meaning: frequency of the electromagnetic wave (s^-1, i.e., Hz)

caution: Energy is directly proportional to frequency. When a photon is absorbed or emitted, the species' energy changes by exactly this amount.

title: Wavelength, frequency, and speed of light

items.label: c
items.meaning: speed of light (m/s)

items.label: \lambda
items.meaning: wavelength of the electromagnetic wave (m)

items.label: \nu
items.meaning: frequency of the electromagnetic wave (s^-1, i.e., Hz)

caution: Wavelength and frequency are inversely proportional because c is constant. Keep wavelength units consistent with the units of c.

title: Beer-Lambert law

items.label: A
items.meaning: absorbance (unitless)

items.label: \varepsilon
items.meaning: molar absorptivity, how intensely a species absorbs light of a specific wavelength (units such as L·mol^-1·cm^-1)

items.label: b
items.meaning: path length of light through the solution (e.g., cm)

items.label: c
items.meaning: concentration of the absorbing species (e.g., mol/L)

caution: When path length and wavelength are held constant, absorbance is proportional only to the concentration of the absorbing species.

title: Ideal gas law

items.label: P
items.meaning: pressure of the gas (units must match R, e.g., atm or kPa)

items.label: V
items.meaning: volume of the gas (units must match R, e.g., L)

items.label: n
items.meaning: amount of gas (mol)

items.label: R
items.meaning: universal gas constant (choose the value whose units match P and V)

items.label: T
items.meaning: absolute temperature (K)

caution: T must be in kelvin. Real gases deviate from this law when interparticle attractions matter (near condensation) or particle volume matters (extremely high pressure).

items.label: X_A
items.meaning: mole fraction of gas A in the mixture (unitless)

items.label: n_A
items.meaning: moles of gas A (mol)

items.label: n_{total}
items.meaning: total moles of all gases in the mixture (mol)

title: Partial pressure from mole fraction

items.label: P_A
items.meaning: partial pressure of gas A (same pressure units as P_total)

items.label: P_{total}
items.meaning: total pressure of the gas mixture

items.label: X_A
items.meaning: mole fraction of gas A (unitless)

caution: Applies to a mixture of ideal gases, where each component's partial pressure is independent of the other components.

title: Total pressure of a gas mixture

items.label: P_{total}
items.meaning: total pressure of the gas mixture

items.label: P_A, P_B, P_C
items.meaning: partial pressures of each component gas, in the same pressure units

caution: Applies to a mixture of ideal gases, where each partial pressure is independent of the other components.

title: Average kinetic energy of a particle

items.label: KE
items.meaning: average kinetic energy of a particle (J)

items.label: m
items.meaning: mass of the particle (kg)

items.label: v
items.meaning: average velocity (speed) of the particle (m/s)

caution: Use consistent units (e.g., J, kg, m/s). Kelvin temperature is proportional to the average kinetic energy of the particles.

title: Molarity

items.label: M
items.meaning: molarity (mol/L)

items.label: n_{solute}
items.meaning: amount of solute (mol)

items.label: L_{solution}
items.meaning: volume of the solution (L)

caution: The denominator is liters of solution, not liters of solvent.
